description.value: Kawawa is an all-you-can-eat Japanese restaurant located inside Metropolis at Metrotown, one of BC's largest shopping centres in central Burnaby. The restaurant offers an extensive menu spanning sushi, ramen, rolls, sashimi, tempura, and seasonal specials, with both à la carte and all-you-can-eat options in a roomy dining room. Its mall setting provides easy access to a full commercial hub, making it a substantial refuelling stop for cyclists riding the Kingsway corridor.
